target_customer: Pharma and biotech companies that need hard to make molecules for early drug discovery
problem: Planning and making difficult molecules takes years of iteration. b12 uses AI agents with robotic partner labs to plan and run chemistry end to end.
business_model: Paid pilots and services with pharma customers, running the b12 Foundry lab system

founders.name: Zlatko Jončev
founders.background_notes: YC page: three time National Chemistry Olympiad champion, competed at IChO level.

founders.name: Andres Bran
founders.background_notes: YC page: built an autonomous chemistry agent published in Nature Machine Intelligence (ChemCrow per a conference profile).

technical_complexity.rationale: Combines LLM planning agents with robotic lab hardware and real chemistry validation, which requires research grade AI and automation integration.

defensibility.rationale: Founders' academic reputation, lab partnerships and accumulated experiment data help, but well funded rivals can hire similar talent.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large funded AI science companies (Lila Sciences 235M and Periodic Labs 300M seed, both September 2025 per press) emerged around the batch; no acquisition of b12 found.

market_need_then: Pharma is paying for pilots; the company claims paid pilots with large pharma where a planned experiment set achieved full conversion on the first attempt (company claim, unverified).

branding.domain_note: Uses b12-labs.com; other companies named B12 exist.
branding.community_and_virality: Presence at SLAS 2026 lab automation event per an exhibitor listing; no wider community evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with the vitamin and a website builder also called B12; little press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: b12 Labs is an Active Summer 2025 company with strong founder credentials in AI chemistry and early paid pharma pilots by its own account. It has launched the b12 Foundry and exhibits at lab automation events, but funding and revenue are not confirmed publicly, so outcome is still open.
notes: Company website fetch was blocked by a rate-limited safety check, so site content was not read. Funding unverified and conflicting: one profile says about 130K seed (August 2025), another aggregator 500K pre-seed in September 2025 with YC and possibly Sunset Ventures; no Form D found per a directory. No round recorded. Founding year not found. Competitor evidence is a single dated article title and URL date, with no details read; later rivals are noted in takeover_risk_then. Education for Zlatko is only the EPFL postdoc listed on the YC page.
